title: Jain Friendly Indulgent Malaysian Coconut Milk Biryani
description: A resinous and pillowy Malaysian dish made with baking powder and coconut milk, this jain-friendly biryani is a true indulgence. It features a blend of aromatic spices and fluffy basmati rice.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the coriander powder and salt and stir well.
Add the basmati rice and stir to coat the rice with the spice mixture.
Add the coconut milk and 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan with a tight fitting lid.
Let the biryani rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
